scope: All1763 old parsed native histories/32342 assistant positions, regardless of old93/106 admission; not all175 physical roots or a global data-size upper bound.
length_evidence: All1763 existing full-stage input_id arrays rehashed; all32342 source message hashes and assistant body boundaries matched. Original proof modes:82 independent second-tokenizer calls,1681 deterministic reuse of byte-identical assets. This run independently checks both local asset sets/header encoding but does not recompile55M full-stage tokens or claim fresh dual calls for1763.

near_proxy.scope: same corrected role; normalized first4096 characters; bottom128 character5-shingle sketch; SimHash64 four16-bit bands, hamming<=3, length ratio>=.8, sketch overlap>=.9; <=1000 candidates/band and200000 comparisons

duplicate_proxies.exact_action_payload_definition: Original visible text plus original call names and exact arguments, omitting only generated native call IDs; identical actions in different contexts are not automatically redundant training records.

source_boundary_interpretation.HOLD_PROTECTED: Existing v6 actual direct/resource-prefix protected evidence; not old prepare policy-string flags.
source_boundary_interpretation.HOLD_MISSING: Resource/source lineage unproven; not proven protected and not a quality rejection.
source_boundary_interpretation.ADMIT: Source/resource scope only, not semantic quality or full-pipeline readiness.
source_boundary_interpretation.source_id_lists_in_catalog: Availability/route metadata are retained separately and not called actual read proof or independent task identity.
source_boundary_interpretation.label_granularity: Existing v6 episode-scope status distribution only. A protected dependency later in an episode is not retrospective proof that every earlier target prefix saw it. This audit neither admits nor deletes targets using these episode labels; safe-prefix recovery needs exact temporal resource closure.
source_boundary_interpretation.HOLD_MISSING_EVIDENCE: Resource/source lineage unproven; not proven protected and not a semantic-quality rejection.

interpretation_limits: A structurally paired successful tool call or exit0 is not task-quality gold, resource reliability, retention validity or autonomous skill-distillation success.
A failed test/probe or running poll can be a valid training action. Temporal failure→edit candidates require semantic and version-bound receipt review; no repair success is inferred here.

Visible assistant explanations may convey decision evidence; no claim that tool syntax alone teaches route selection, evaluation or full controller policy. Independent recorded reasoning is not fabricated from text.

The recovered schema registry contains fixed-image tool definitions plus incomplete original placeholders. Schema coverage is recoverable-interface evidence, not proof of exact per-request original tool access policy.

Persisted details truncation and visible output markers are counted separately; canonical logs cannot establish all omitted raw API/context bytes. Custom messages/aborted turns remain evidence, not fabricated assistant thoughts.
Serialized causal lengths use the already declared v4 training template, not a claim that each native API request had this exact prefix or lacked native context management.

Exact response repetitions can be appropriate under different contexts; normalized path/ID/number templates can merge behaviorally different code. Near-proxy edges are bounded operational similarity, not semantic equivalence and never an automatic deletion policy.
Grouped source memberships overlap. Routes, attempts, repeated targets, resource versions and independent enterprise tasks are different units.
This is a diagnostic all-population ledger and stratified review list, not a newly admitted SFT dataset or evidence that14B meets the complete autonomous goal.
context_length_scope_warning: All16K/32K figures describe the old derived training representation's causal prefixes, not complete original native API requests. Captured system/tools are incomplete; same-episode wire/runtime recovery can increase lengths and requires final recompilation. Equal token/mask identity of the declared representation does not prove faithful recovery of all teacher schemas or student tool compatibility.

capture_completeness.interpretation: Capture-layer incompleteness, not a blanket semantic-quality rejection. Full wire records found in other sessions cannot be borrowed to fill these episodes. Exact same-identity recovery remains a separate task; all original process evidence is retained.

decision_field_proxy_definition: Only parseable original assistant text or write-tool JSON content; keys decision/verdict/reuse_decision/retention_decision/final_decision/next_action/retain/keep/revise. Presence is a review locator, not proof of meaningful reasoning, correct choices or causal repair success. No teacher field was synthesized.
training_toolset_interpretation: core7_only/noncore_only/text_only/empty target classes cover the whole population. Prior-v4 positive/zero loss and recovered-schema unknown/arguments-invalid counts are separately tabulated. No filtering to93/106 or claim that every teacher action fits a seven-tool student adapter.

external_model_dependency_proxies.interpretation: All original toolCall parameter strings inspected, including exec commands and written code. Mentions can be documentation/inspection or code not yet run, and wrappers/loops can hide additional real calls. These are dependency locators, never actual API invocation or billed-token counts. sessions_spawn blocks are native delegation requests, not the subagent's downstream call count. A text14B student continuing to use external vision/image/speech/text/delegation has not replaced all large-model compute; cost per qualified skill must include those tool-model bills and uncertainty.
